scope: Slide 9 comparison and new slide 11. Zcash remains slide 10. The deck now contains 24 slides.

confirmed_from_primary_docs.privacy: Inside-pool transfers conceal public counterparties/amounts. Swaps expose assets and amounts but not the user. Pool deposits and withdrawals publish boundary information; the operator can read balances and history.
confirmed_from_primary_docs.fees: 0.5% deposits, 0.5% withdrawals; no Nullmask protocol fee for swaps, with exchange and network fees still applicable.
confirmed_from_primary_docs.networks: Official network and swap documentation lists Ethereum and Base; the slide does not infer live Solana service from the token being on Solana.
confirmed_from_primary_docs.token_metrics: Analytics tracks MASK burns and ZEC holder distributions. Its reported revenue combines platform fees with ZEC rewards paid to the development wallet.
confirmed_from_primary_docs.roadmap: Solana integration and private perpetuals are Q4 2026 roadmap targets, not established delivered features.

not_independently_verified: Fee-to-MASK buyback routing or a guaranteed fee entitlement
Repeat users or monthly active users
Token lockups and team allocation promises from social posts
Broader chain support beyond the official network documentation
